transliteration: Iqra bismi rab bikal lazee khalaq

translations.en.sahih: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
translations.en.pickthall: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
translations.en.yusufali: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-
translations.id.indonesian: Bacalah dengan (menyebut) nama Tuhanmu Yang menciptakan,

translations.en.sahih: Created man from a clinging substance.
translations.en.yusufali: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:
translations.id.indonesian: Dia telah menciptakan manusia dari segumpal darah.

translations.en.sahih: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
translations.en.pickthall: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
translations.en.yusufali: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-
translations.id.indonesian: Bacalah, dan Tuhanmulah Yang Maha Pemurah,

translations.en.yusufali: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-

translations.en.sahih: Taught man that which he knew not.
translations.en.pickthall: Teacheth man that which he knew not.
translations.en.yusufali: Taught man that which he knew not.
translations.id.indonesian: Dia mengajar kepada manusia apa yang tidak diketahuinya.

translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but verily man is rebellious
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds,
translations.id.indonesian: Ketahuilah! Sesungguhnya manusia benar-benar melampaui batas,

translations.en.yusufali: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.
translations.id.indonesian: karena dia melihat dirinya serba cukup.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen the one who forbids
translations.en.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
translations.id.indonesian: Bagaimana pendapatmu tentang orang yang melarang,

translations.en.yusufali: A votary when he (turns) to pray?

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
translations.en.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
translations.en.yusufali: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-
translations.id.indonesian: bagaimana pendapatmu jika orang yang melarang itu berada di atas kebenaran,

transliteration: Ara-aita in kaz zaba wa ta walla

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
translations.en.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?
translations.en.yusufali: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?
translations.id.indonesian: Bagaimana pendapatmu jika orang yang melarang itu mendustakan dan berpaling?

transliteration: Alam y'alam bi-an nal lahaa yaraa

translations.en.sahih: Does he not know that Allah sees?
translations.en.pickthall: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?
translations.en.yusufali: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see?
translations.id.indonesian: Tidaklah dia mengetahui bahwa sesungguhnya Allah melihat segala perbuatannya?

arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
transliteration: Kalla la illam yantahi la nasfa'am bin nasiyah

translations.en.sahih: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -
translations.en.yusufali: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-
translations.id.indonesian: Ketahuilah, sungguh jika dia tidak berhenti (berbuat demikian) niscaya Kami tarik ubun-ubunnya,
(yaitu) ubun-ubun orang yang mendustakan lagi durhaka.

translations.en.sahih: Then let him call his associates;
translations.en.pickthall: Then let him call upon his henchmen!
translations.en.yusufali: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):
translations.id.indonesian: Maka biarlah dia memanggil golongannya (untuk menolongnya),

translations.en.sahih: We will call the angels of Hell.
translations.en.pickthall: We will call the guards of hell.
translations.en.yusufali: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!
translations.id.indonesian: kelak Kami akan memanggil malaikat Zabaniyah,

translations.en.sahih: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!
translations.id.indonesian: sekali-kali jangan, janganlah kamu patuh kepadanya; dan sujudlah dan dekatkanlah (dirimu kepada Tuhan).
